beetalents-bee-talents:lever:7f8d0f69-4c.title: HR & Operations Manager | Reforma Nieruchomości [12-16k PLN/mies. B2B]
beetalents-bee-talents:lever:7f8d0f69-4c.description: Kim jesteśmy? Cześć, nazywamy się Bee Talents i od 2015 roku zajmujemy się budowaniem zespołów w różnych branżach na całym świecie. Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla klienta Reforma Nieruchomości. Reforma Nieruchomości to firma, która od 12 lat z sukcesami rozwija się na poznańskim rynku. Nie zajmuje się masowym budownictwem - aktywnie uczestniczy w kształtowaniu wizerunku miasta, pracując z jego historyczną tkanką i zabytkowymi kamienicami. Od początku swojej działalności podejmuje odważne decyzje, sięgając po projekty wymagające najwyższej odpowiedzialności, rzetelności oraz inżynieryjnego kunsztu. Ich działania zostały docenione m.in. prestiżową nagrodą przyznaną przez Narodowy Instytut Dziedzictwa. Działa w sektorze unikalnych inwestycji mieszkaniowych, realizując nieszablonowe i zaawansowane technicznie projekty, w których kluczową rolę odgrywa wysoka estetyka, dbałość o detal oraz przywracanie budynkom drugiego życia z uwzględnieniem rozwiązań ekologicznych. Obecnie Reformę Nieruchomości tworzy 20-osobowy zespół, który w codziennej pracy kieruje się jasno określonymi wartościami. Jej dewiza to: „jedyną stałą rzeczą jest zmiana”. Tworzy środowisko, które daje ogromną przestrzeń do kreowania rzeczywistości, ale wymaga też elastyczności, szybkiego reagowania na nowe okoliczności oraz świadomej, dojrzałej analizy celów. Tak więc co robi? 🏣 kupuje budynki i remontuje je doprowadza w nich lokale mieszkalne i niemieszkalne do stanu deweloperskiego następnie sprzedaje te lokale Reforma Nieruchomości jest deweloperem rewitalizacyjnym. Główne wyzwanie: W związku z szybkim rozwojem organizacji oraz powiększaniem się zespołu, przechodzi obecnie z etapu zarządzania intuicyjnego na etap systemowy, dlatego dziś zapraszamy do współpracy doświadczoną osobę, która obejmie nowo utworzone stanowisko: HR & Operations Manager Szukamy samodzielnego specjalisty o silnych kompetencjach organizacyjnych i głębokim poczuciu odpowiedzialności za powierzone obszary. Jeśli chcesz być partnerem dla Zarządu, który nie tylko wykonuje odgórne procedury, ale samodzielnie projektuje, wdraża i nadaje tor standardom zarządzania ludźmi oraz procesami biurowymi - ta rola jest dla Ciebie.

Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6f2148e2-2ee5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager based in Saudi Arabia. This is a commercially focused role for a digital marketing professional who can turn online visibility into measurable revenue growth. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Own the organic search strategy across SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation, and Generative Engine Optimisation, including keyword research, competitor analysis, technical optimisation, structured data, internal linking, content architecture, and search-intent analysis. Optimise product, category, service, and location-based pages to improve rankings and visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Develop commercially focused content around pricing, bulk purchasing, product comparisons, specifications, delivery information, and frequently asked questions. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Develop strategies to increase average order value, purchase frequency, and repeat revenue through bundles, volume offers, cross-selling, upselling, promotions, and abandoned-cart recovery. Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, display, and relevant Meta or LinkedIn channels. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. Build segmented email marketing and automated lifecycle campaigns covering new enquiries, quote follow-ups, abandoned carts, account applications, repeat-order reminders, customer reactivation, product launches, and promotions. Analyse campaign, CRM, website, and sales data to identify which marketing activities generate customers and revenue rather than relying on vanity metrics. Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering leads, quote requests, e-commerce sales, conversion rates, organic performance, advertising efficiency, average order value, repeat purchasing, and marketing-attributed revenue. Identify priority products, customer segments, and growth opportunities in collaboration with sales and management teams. Continuously test, measure, and refine marketing initiatives to improve commercial performance and establish clear attribution between digital activity and revenue.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:be0383f4-db4.description: Job Description: Language Lead – Malagasy (Madagascar) Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Language Lead – Malagasy (Madagascar) to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong linguistic background, expertise in the Malagasy language, and the ability to lead projects with a focus on quality and efficiency. The Language Lead will oversee linguistic tasks, manage quality assurance, and provide mentorship to linguists while ensuring the delivery of high-quality language services. Key Responsibilities: Linguistic Expertise: Provide expert-level translation, localization, and linguistic support for Malagasy language projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy, cultural appropriateness, and contextual relevance in all deliverables. Quality Assurance: Review and edit translations to ensure they meet client requirements and quality standards. Implement quality control processes and resolve linguistic issues, including terminology consistency and style adherence. Project Leadership: Lead Malagasy language projects from initiation to completion, ensuring deadlines and quality benchmarks are met. Collaborate with project managers, clients, and other linguists to meet project goals. Team Management & Mentorship: Provide guidance and support to linguists and junior team members. Facilitate training and development opportunities for the team to enhance skills and expertise. Terminology and Style Guide Development: Develop and maintain Malagasy language glossaries, style guides, and linguistic resources. Ensure adherence to client-specific requirements and language standards. Client Communication: Serve as a point of contact for linguistic queries and feedback from clients. Manage and address client concerns related to Malagasy language services. Requirements: Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Translation Studies, Language Arts, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional experience in translation, localization, or linguistic services. At least 2 years of experience as a Language Lead or in a Senior Linguist position. Language Skills: Native or near-native proficiency in Malagasy, with excellent command of English (additional language proficiency is a plus). Technical Skills: Familiarity with translation and localization tools (e.g., CAT tools, TMS systems). Strong knowledge of linguistic quality assurance processes. Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and leadership abilities. Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working in the localization/translation industry for global clients. Knowledge of Madagascar’s cultural and regional linguistic nuances. Certification in translation or localization tools is an advantage. Application Process: Please submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio demonstrating your linguistic expertise and leadership experience.
